title: Red Rocks
html:
Quest Giver: Kingdom Representative

Quest Type: Retrieve Item

Quest Description: Collect 12 Fizz Rock Samples from Whiskers in Dew Valley

Quest Reward: 500 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Kingdom Representative

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 12 samples of Fizz Rock from Dew Valley Forest. Afterward, return to Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative in Dew Valley.

Offer:

You have proven to be of great help in controlling the Whisker population.

I am still trying to discover why their numbers have increased so much lately. I have reason to believe it is somehow linked to Fizz Rock, which is hard to find in Dew Valley Forest thanks to overmining by the Whiskers.

I have heard rumors that they may have found new veins of Fizz Rock, Fizz Rock with *highly* unusual properties, and this could be linked to their recent explosion in population. With a proper amount of rock samples, I could discover the dangers it might pose to the Kingdom.

Collect these samples and return to me, Sir Prize the Kingdom Representative, here in Dew Valley.

Turn-in:

*Cough! Cough!* My word! These rocks have such a pungent odor! Nevertheless, well done. You are well on your way to proving your worthiness. Come back soon...I might have some more work for you.

Objectives:

  • Fizz Rock ×12

Level range: 2–15
